hard_rules: No outcome-based family/trait clustering or sorting for inferential storytelling.
Do not encode family > trait or system > family as a significance comparison.
Do not label the old residual share as system specificity.
Do not label negative unshrunk gain as anti-portability.
Keep the all-201 log-scale HOLD visible; no offset or selected-subset rescue.
Deep-family-phylogeny exploratory result belongs in Supplement or a complementary panel, not a primary inferential pillar.
current_central_claim: Phylogenetic trait memory is lineage-contingent rather than a stable trait-intrinsic signature.
